title: Adopt the GREG Polyintelligence Cortex seed (cortex 0.1.4) into the Kernel as a SANDBOXED, unpromoted experiment
problem: GREG answers mixed-geometry questions through single-model reasoning with no epistemic jurisdiction, typed proof, gates-before-ranking or outcome-only learning. The founder ordered a seed experiment; it is built on a draft branch. Merging it adds five names to the shared Kernel contract registry and a CI job; it creates no authority and no external effect.
baseline: main at 19fa33c: no cortex; Capability Genome, policy engine, causal memory and Consequence Gate exist; no capability or model router is implemented.

alternatives.name: Strong single model with tools
alternatives.description: Route every question to one strong model with code execution and solver tool calls; no gates, typed proofs or settlement.
advantages: LLMRouterBench shows Best Single is hard to beat
disadvantages: no authority separation in the artifact
alternatives.revival_evidence: Declared baselines run and the routed seed shows GAIN_ABSENT with no critical-error advantage.

alternatives.name: Full 16-family cortex now
alternatives.description: Implement every family the review lists before evaluating.
disadvantages: architecture cathedral the review itself warns against
no evidence any family beats its baseline
alternatives.revival_evidence: Node 1 GAIN_VERIFIED and recorded deficits on specific geometries.

alternatives.name: Gate-and-receipt layer only
alternatives.description: Keep gates, typed receipts and the verifier around a single model, without routing to exact organs.
disadvantages: loses exactness where solvers dominate (formal, optimization, units)
alternatives.revival_evidence: Routing shows no gain but gates/verifier reduce critical errors against baselines.

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Branch stays a draft; main keeps single-model cognition; evidence and primitives remain available but unused.

roles.position: Every line of the build prompt and every section of both review passes is traced with a status; the literal dominance clause is preserved and prohibited, its lawful effect carried forward.
material_concerns: 'Verbatim' conflicts with the review's own corrections (PC-010) and needs a founder ruling
Exit condition unmet; the build prompt requires reporting that and staying unpromoted

roles.position: The cortex is a projection of the Capability Genome with one integration edit (five contract names); no second registry, ledger or authority path; stacks cleanly on PR #137.
material_concerns: Adds shared contract names to KNOWN_CONTRACTS, which makes this constitutional-level
Routing is structural; free-text intake does not exist yet

roles.position: The strongest counterexample stands: LLMRouterBench reports routers often fail to beat the best single model; the 0.964 is on self-authored structured items. Nothing here shows the router is better than a strong model with tools.
material_concerns: Weak local baseline could manufacture gain
Four post-freeze fixes, though disclosed, show the first freeze was premature

roles.position: Reproducible: one optional dependency, frozen manifests per version, CI job runs tests, traceability, register, mutation check and the held-out refusal guard.
material_concerns: Documentation volume is high; maintainers must keep the matrix and register current
Mutation patterns go stale when code moves (the stale guard caught one)

roles.position: Victim protection is human-led with identity-free receipts; unknown harm is treated as possible harm; abstention is credited so the system is not pushed into confident error.
material_concerns: No held-out item exercises protection, timeouts or optimization
Who actually receives protective handoffs is undefined

evidence.finding: 0.964 [0.911, 1.000], zero critical errors, unsupported certainty and gate violations; self-authored items
receipts schema-pinned to authority_created=false; no actuator import; financial/irreversible hand off
clean merge; 1297 passed vs 1201 for #137 alone, same 12 skips
LLMRouterBench: several routers do not beat Best Single

counterevidence.finding: four disclosed fixes after the v0.1 freeze (protection, timeout, exit rule, review primitives)
only a scripted model client was tested; no live model

pass_1.intended_outcome: A reversible, consequence-inert cognition seed on main that later stages can build on, promoted only by evidence.

advantages.statement: Exact organs remove error classes a model cannot (SMT, unit algebra, identification rules)
advantages.amplified_value: certified optimization and witness checks turn exactness into auditable receipts

advantages.statement: Authority-free receipts with falsifiers narrow disputes
advantages.amplified_value: every claim names what would refute it, so accountability compounds with use
competence can compound from reality without any path to sovereignty

disadvantages.statement: No comparative evidence against strong baselines
disadvantages.redesigned_response: exit rule requires every declared baseline, per-geometry gain, cost and latency; promotion blocked until then
Node 2 requires an externally authored free-text suite before any shadow use

disadvantages.statement: Adds names to the shared contract registry
disadvantages.redesigned_response: cortex schemas kept out of the shared-boundary allowlist; one-line registry change; founder decision required to merge
matrix and register are tested, so drift fails CI instead of rotting

comparisons.baseline: main has no cognition routing; the seed adds it without touching any authority path
comparisons.do_nothing: keeps main simplest but leaves the founder directive and primitives off main
comparisons.simplest_viable_alternative: gate-and-receipt layer only; retained as the fallback if routing shows no gain
comparisons.strongest_competing_architecture: strong single model with tools; it is the declared baseline the seed must beat
comparisons.reversible_experiment: merge as SANDBOXED and consequence-inert; revert is one merge revert; run baselines next

rejected_alternatives.name: Full 16-family cortex now
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: GAIN_VERIFIED plus recorded deficits per geometry

rejected_alternatives.name: Promote on the 0.964 result
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: GAIN_VERIFIED on an external suite against strong baselines

pass_2.attack_summary: Attacked the strengthened design for evaluator capture, documentation bureaucracy, centralization of cognition in one router, and drift between frozen evidence and code.

new_weaknesses.statement: Each fix needs a version bump, freeze, rerun and doc update
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: kept: the friction is what makes post-hoc changes visible; scripts make it mechanical

new_weaknesses.statement: The author can tune the exit rule after seeing results
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: exit tightened only before any baseline ran; every manifest and result preserved; rule changes only add conditions

new_weaknesses.statement: One router could become a de facto authority
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: schema pins authority_created=false; static import test; learning cannot touch the registry

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: decided by running the declared baselines

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: a traceability or register test fails

pass_2.final_design: Cortex 0.1.4 as on the branch: SANDBOXED seed organs, 28 reserved families disabled, gates before ranking, typed proofs, accountability and protection in receipts, outcome-only settlement, frozen evaluation with a strict exit, CI job 6. Merge only by founder decision; no promotion without GAIN_VERIFIED.

residual_risks.mitigation: kill test retires the performance claim; gate-and-receipt fallback

residual_risks.risk: Protective handoff has no named human recipient
residual_risks.mitigation: handoffs name the next step; recipient designation is a founder decision

dissent.handling: Preserved with an evidence threshold; it does not block the draft but blocks promotion.

entries.position: Do not treat the seed as evidence of routing value until strong baselines run.
entries.rationale: Best Single is hard to beat (LLMRouterBench); the suite is self-authored.
entries.evidence_threshold: GAIN_VERIFIED against a strong always-LLM and a committee on the frozen suite, then on an external suite

migration_plan: Merge the draft branch after founder review; no data migration; cortex stays SANDBOXED; earlier freeze manifests and results kept.

steps: remove the five cortex names from KNOWN_CONTRACTS in the same revert
CI job 6 disappears with the revert

kill_criteria: GAIN_ABSENT against strong baselines on two frozen versions with no critical-error advantage
any receipt found asserting authority or any cortex import of an actuator
review_trigger: Founder review of the draft PR, or a Node 1 verdict.
